items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: That's where I started with Lane. I was in short pants.

ctx.x: You see? That's a bad thing to say. That's why we called him yellow. Because he was olive complexion, you see? That's a bad thing to say. That's why we called him yellow. Because he was olive complexion, you see? Sam Charles told me about yellow. He knew that. No, he wasn't one of those. Papa Lane and Mama Lane said that he was white. He was white. Yeah. They knew it.
